messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['To avoid the loss of your account, you are required to upgrade your Mailbox account by clicking on the link below to enable the increase in the storage quota of your account.', 'Our record indicates that you recently made a request to shut down your email and this request will be processed shortly.', 'To have your online account reinstated, you need to renew your online service access.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "Upgrade your mailbox to increase storage, renew online service access to restore your account, or expect your requested email shutdown to proceed."}
